raw_segments.text: Will you give me a piece of bread, for I am very hungry?"
He cast on me a glance of surprise, but without answering he cut a thick slice from his loaf
I imagine he did not think I was a beggar, but only an eccentric sort of lady who had
taken a fancy to his brown loaf.
As soon as I was out of sight of his house, I sat down and ate it.
